files./etc/systemd/system/os-security-audit.se:
[Unit]
Description=OS security audit

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/bin/os-lua run-security-audit
Nice=19
IOSchedulingClass=idle
files./etc/systemd/system/os-security-audit.ti:
[Unit]
Description=Weekly OS security audit

[Timer]
OnCalendar=weekly
Persistent=true
RandomizedDelaySec=1h

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
files./etc/logrotate.d/os-security-audit:
/var/log/lynis-audit.log /var/log/rkhunter-audit.log /var/log/arch-audit.log /var/log/clamav/os-scan.log {
    weekly
    rotate 12
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    create 640 root root
}
